findings.source_quote: It was a small cut, only about one quarter of an inch long, but it had gone in rather deeply.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the measurement accurately. Replace the Swedish phrase that gives the length as "ungefär en halv centimeter" with an accurate metric equivalent of one quarter of an inch (≈0,64 cm). For example: "bara ungefär 0,64 centimeter lång" or a rounded "bara ungefär 0,6 centimeter lång". Preserve the sentence structure and surrounding HTML.
findings.translation_quote: Det var ett litet snitt, bara ungefär en halv centimeter långt, men det gick ganska djupt.
